parts.text: A student investigates the reflection of light by two plane mirrors. The student’s ray-trace sheet is shown full-size in Fig. 3.1. Fig. 3.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) The student places two mirrors, FE and FG , at an angle of 100° to each other, as shown in Fig. 3.1.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) On Fig. 3.1, draw a normal to FG at point N . Extend the normal below FG . Label the lower end of the normal with the letter L . [1]

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) The student draws line AN , as shown in Fig. 3.1. On Fig. 3.1, measure the acute angle θ 1 between the lines AN and GN . (An acute angle is less than 90°.) θ 1 = ........................................................° [1]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) The student places two pins, P 1 and P 2 , on line AN , as shown in Fig. 3.1.

ms.label: 3(b)(ii)
ms.text: no and too close / must be as far apart as possible

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) The student views the images of P 1 and P 2 in mirror FE . She places two pins, P 3 and P 4 , so that pins P 3 , P 4 and the images of P 1 and P 2 all appear one behind the other. • Draw a line through P 3 and P 4 . Extend the line 10 cm above FE . • Label the upper end of this line with the letter R . • Label the lower end of the line with the letter B . [1]

ms.label: 3(c)
ms.text: all lines fine, straight and in correct relation

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) The student repeats the procedure for an angle θ 2 = 40°. She places two pins, P 5 and P 6 , so that pins P 5 , P 6 and the images of P 1 and P 2 all appear one behind the other. • Draw a line through pins P 5 and P 6 . Extend the line until it crosses BR . • Label the upper end of this line with the letter T . • Label the lower end of the line with the letter C .

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Measure the acute angle α between lines BR and CT . (An acute angle is less than 90°.) α = ........................................................° [1]

ms.label: 3(d)(ii)
ms.text:
statement matching results
justification matching statement and quoting values

ms.label: 3(e)
ms.text:
any two suitable precautions, e.g.:

thin lines / sharp pencil

view bottom of pins / keep pins upright

ensure pins far apart

ms.label: 3(f)
ms.text: difficult to align pins / place pins accurately / pins (too) thick
